text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Io and {0} safely make it back to shore.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}とイオは、無事に再上陸していた。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
We finally got back to the beach!
It's all thanks to you that we didn't go adrift.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようやくビーチまで帰ってこられたわ～
漂流しなかったのは、
君のおかげね～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you must be exhausted after that, right?
Then let's take a little break.
I'll treat you to something refreshing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一生懸命浮き輪で漕いでくれたから、
きっとヘトヘトよね？
ちょっと休みましょっか。
私がごちそうするわね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!
text_block_list.orig_text: すみませーん！

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text: Hi there! Welcome!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
いらっしゃーい！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Could we have two of your special tropical juices?
text_block_list.orig_text:
このオススメの
特製トロピカルジュースを二つお願いします。

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Sorry.
We're actually all out of fruit, so I can't make enough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ悪いねえ、
お姉さん。
実はフルーツの在庫が切れて、
人数分作れないんだよ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: A-aww...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなぁ〜……

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though. There's enough left for one,
so how about you share it with your boyfriend?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
あと一つ分だけの材料はあるから、
彼氏さんとシェアで良ければ作れるよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
M-my boyfriend?!
We're not in that sort of relationship!
text_block_list.orig_text:
か、
彼氏だなんて！
私たちそんなんじゃ〜

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
You not down for it, then?
How about you, my man?
You look like you're choking for a drink.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、
やめとくかい？
お兄さんはどうだい？　
飲みたいだろ？
このオススメの特製トロピカルジュースを。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, you little rascal!
You promised you'd do what I say!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
こら〜！
先生の話はちゃんと聞くって約束でしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You're the one that got us back to the beach, though.
I'd rather not make us look like a couple, but oh well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
さっきは君のおかげでビーチまで戻ってこられたんだし、
カップルみたいなことしちゃうけど、
仕方ないわよね〜……

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text: That's what I like to hear!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
決まりだな！

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Here you go.
I put two straws in there, so drink away.
Enjoy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、おまちどうさん。
ストローは二本差してあるから、
仲良く飲むんだよ。
ごゆっくり〜

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Wow! This looks lovely!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあー、
素敵なジュースね！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wait. I thought I made it clear that we're not a couple!
We're just student and teacher! Back me up here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
だから私たちそんなんじゃなくて、
先生と生徒なのに〜
君も何か言ってよ～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! I almost forgot!
You go first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大変！　
そうだったわ！
どうぞ、先に飲んでちょうだい！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't drink it all!
I know you're thirsty,
but you'll drink my share at that rate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こら、
ちょっと飲み過ぎよ〜！
喉が渇いてるのは分かるけど、
私の分がなくなっちゃうじゃない〜！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Argh! I'll just have to fight back!
*siiiiiip*
text_block_list.orig_text:
もー、
こうなったら私だって……！
ちゅぅ〜〜〜

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Delicious!
What a rich flavor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～、
とってもおいしい！
濃厚な味ね～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I guess you're right. He said it uses fresh fruits,
so it's probably close to their natural flavor.
This is the perfect drink for summer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよね～、
新鮮なフルーツを使ってるって言ってたし、
自然そのままの味に近い気がするわ。
これこそ、夏の飲み物だね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious enough to make your heart thump, right?
You're making me extra glad that I got it for us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ドキドキと胸の鼓動が高鳴るほど、おいしいってことね！
そう言ってもらえると、
ごちそうした甲斐があったわ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wait! We ended up drinking it together!
But it's so delicious that I can't hold back anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
つい一緒に飲んじゃったわ～！
でも、
本当においしいから、
もう我慢できないかも～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
We've only got one, so let's drink it together.
I'll get mad if you take another huge sip, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一つしかないから、
二人で一緒に味わいましょう？
また飲み過ぎたら怒るからね～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
That was great!
I'm feeling all refreshed now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしかったー！　
元気回復！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Now then. It's time for round three!
I need to get some actual swimming practice done!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さてと、
第３ラウンドの開始～！
今度こそ、ちゃんと
泳ぐ練習をしなきゃよね〜

text_block_list.name: Boyfriend
text_block_list.text:
Today was super fun!
How about we get ready to head home?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は楽しかったね～！
そろそろ帰ろうかっ！

text_block_list.name: Girlfriend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's getting late.
We sure played lots!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
こんな時間だもんね。
いっぱい遊んじゃった～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Oh no! The sun's starting to set!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
大変！　
いつの間に夕方になっていたの～？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Sad as it, today was incredibly satisfying.
I never did manage to swim oroperly,
but I got to have a lot of fun together with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
名残惜しいけど、
大満足の一日だったわ～
泳げるようにはならなかったけど、
今日は君といっぱい遊べたから！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I should return this glass.
Wait a minute for me, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ジュースの容器を返却してくるから、
ちょっと待っててね！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
When was the last time I had this much fun at the beach?
It's been a while since I wore a swimsuit, too.
I even bought this one specifically for today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなに海ではしゃいだのって、
いつ以来かしら……
水着を着るのもひさしぶりだったなぁ。
実は、
思い切って今日のために新調しちゃったし。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Not that I could tell him that, of course.
It'd be embarrassing if he knew his teacher got this excited.
Did I suit it, though?
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生なのに浮かれてちゃいけないかなって、
なんだか恥ずかしかったから彼には言えなかったけど、
似合ってたかな……？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the juice!
text_block_list.orig_text: ごちそうさまでした～

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there! Thanks for bringing the glass back.
And sorry for only being able to make one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、お姉さんか！　
返却どうも。
一つしか出せなくて、
ごめんな。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
It was delicious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
とってもおいしかったです〜！

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha! That's great to hear.
Did you enjoy your date today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっはっは、
そりゃ良かった！
それで、
今日は楽しいデートはできたかい？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please!
I keep telling you it's not like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
も～！　
だから～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
...I did have an incredibly fun day thanks to him, though.
It felt like I was the only one letting myself go.
If anything, I want to make it up to him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
でも、
彼のおかげで今日はすごく楽しかったです。
私だけはしゃぎっぱなしって感じだったから、
何かお礼したいくらい。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
But I can't swim. I don't know much about the ocean, either.
I'm not really sure what I can do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも私、泳げないし、
海のこともあまり知らないし。
どうしようかしら……

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
I've got just the thing for you, miss.
You'll have to stay a bit longer,
but it'll be more than worth it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おぉ、
それならちょうど良いことがあるよ。
帰りが少し遅くなってしまうかもしれないけど、
お姉さんたちにぴったりだと思うことがあるから！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the wait!
I got caught up talking to the owner.
choice_data_list: We should get ready to head home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おまたせー！
海の家の店主さんとちょっと喋り込んじゃって、
遅くなっちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Um...
Could we stick around, just for a bit longer?
Please?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーっと……
あとちょっとだけ付き合って欲しいな！
ね、
お願い。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thanks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！　
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You look a bit worried.
Am I not a teacher worth trusting?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
でも、なんだか不安そうな顔ね。
先生の言うことが信用できないのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. This is a reward for you.
A special one—the sort I can't give you at school.
You'll be fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心して、
君にご褒美をあげたいの。
学校じゃ渡すことができない、
今日限定の特別なご褒美。
悪いようにはしないんだから。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Down we go.
You sit down, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よいしょっと。
君も座って？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Now, close your eyes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
目を閉じて……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Oh! You can open your eyes now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
いいよ、
目をあけて？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well? It's incredibly pretty, isn't it?
I can see the surprise on your face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
どう？　
とってもきれいでしょ？
すごく驚いたって顔をしているわね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You spent the whole day with me,
so I wanted you to see this as thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日一日付き合ってくれたお礼にと思って、
この景色を君に見せたかったの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time I've seen it, too.
I had high hopes, but it went far and above them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は、
私も初めて見たんだ。
こんなにもきれいだなんて……
思ってた以上だわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Do you know why it's glowing like this?
This won't come up on the curriculum for a good while yet,
but it's due to sea sparkles in the—
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうして光っているか分かる？
学校じゃまだだいぶ先に教えることになるんだけど、
海の中にいる夜光虫っていう──

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
...No, never mind.
There's no need to be in teacher mode right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ううん、
なんでもない。
先生っぽいこと言うのは、
今はやめておくわね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hey...
text_block_list.orig_text: あのね……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I had a lot of fun today.
This is the first time I've come to the beach with a boy.
I've always wanted to do that, ever since I was a student.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は、とっても楽しかったわ。
こうして男の子と二人っきりで海に行くなんて、
初めてのことだったし。
学生のころから
ずっと憧れていたの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
In all honest, being with you is so fun
that I sometimes forget that we're teacher and student.
I mean, today's initial plan was to just practice swimming.
text_block_list.orig_text:
君といるのがあんまり楽しくって、
先生と生徒だっていうことを、
つい忘れちゃいそうになるくらいだったのよ。
最初は
泳ぎの練習に来たはずなのにね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
How about you?
I hope I wasn't the only one that enjoyed today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
君はどうだった？　
今日は楽しかったかしら。
楽しんだのは私だけじゃなかったらいいんだけど。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Keep the fact that we came here a secret, okay?
Between teacher and student...
No. Between me and you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日こうして海で遊んだりしたことは、
先生と……
ううん、
私と{0}くんとだけの秘密だからね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Oh...
text_block_list.orig_text: あっ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: It stopped glowing.
text_block_list.orig_text: 海の光が治まっちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
F-forget what I said just there!
I wasn't being serious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんてね！　
今の話は忘れて！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: I'm going to be even stricter as a teacher from here on, so I hope you're ready!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからはいつも以上にビシバシいくんだから、
覚悟しておいてね？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The horizon comes back into view as the ocean's glow fades out,
leaving the pair caught between the stars and the ocean.
text_block_list.orig_text:
次第に海面は光るのをやめて、水平線を取り戻す。
海面と星空の間に再び現れた境界の前に二人は佇むのだった。
